name: gravitas-ai
description: GRAVITAS AI - a real-time simulated AI chat platform (React + Express + Supabase).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client -- --host"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:bundle
